profiles.notes: Qualification routes for September 2027. Choose the route for the diploma being presented. Individual assessment and degree subjects also apply.

requirements.label: Which diploma is assessed
requirements.details: WUR assesses the submitted application individually, using the country that awarded the diploma. When an applicant has multiple diplomas, Admissions selects one for evaluation. An unlisted qualification or an incomplete curriculum requires individual review. Programme subjects and language proficiency are additional conditions.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 1

requirements.label: US diploma · four AP exams or university study
requirements.details: For the US high school diploma route, WUR lists public high schools in the US and schools accredited by Cognia, MSA-CESS, NEASC or WASC. The exam route requires four academic College Board AP results of 3 or higher. Alternatively, complete a first full-time undergraduate year with 30 academic semester credits and a GPA of at least 3.0/4.0. WUR assesses associate degrees individually.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 9

requirements.label: US AP route · distinct exams and exclusions
requirements.details: Overlapping AP subjects count once. Calculus AB and BC count as one; Physics 1 and 2 count as one subject even when the programme requires both exams. The guide lists Art and Design, Capstone, Research, Seminar, Precalculus, Networking, Cybersecurity, Business with Personal Finance and Drawing as examples of ineligible APs.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 12

requirements.label: US AP route · programme subjects

requirements.label: Australia · ATAR and state qualifications
requirements.details: An ATAR of at least 86.00/99.95 is required alongside the relevant state certificate. WUR counts academic sciences, languages, humanities and social sciences. Applied and vocational subjects are excluded. Applicants who followed only part of the Australian curriculum receive individual assessment.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 2

requirements.label: Australia · ACT, NSW and Queensland
requirements.details: With the ACT Senior Secondary Certificate use at least 20 academic standard units, including three major T courses and one minor T course, with unit grades A–C. With the NSW Higher School Certificate use at least 10 academic Board Developed units, including three courses of at least two units, with a performance band of 4 or above. Queensland requires five academic General subjects in units 3 and 4 at A–C.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 2

requirements.label: Australia · SA, NT, Tasmania, Victoria and WA
requirements.details: For SA and NT, present the state certificate with 90 Stage 2 TAS credits at C− or above; at least 60 credits must come from 20-credit subjects. Tasmania requires four Level 3/4 academic subjects at Commendable Achievement or higher. Victoria requires four scored Year 12 unit 3–4 academic subjects with Grade 1–3 results of A–C. WA requires four Year 12 academic ATAR courses each with a combined mark of 65 or above.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 2

requirements.label: Canada · provincial curriculum and course selection
requirements.details: WUR’s published routes assume at least two years in the provincial curriculum. Shorter attendance is assessed individually. Use academic subjects; applied or vocational subjects are excluded and overlaps count once. Check the separate rules for the province granting the diploma.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 3

requirements.label: Canada · Grade 12 routes with a 75% average
requirements.details: With the corresponding provincial award or transcript, average at least 75% across five academic Grade 12 courses or credits. Alberta, Northwest Territories and Nunavut use codes 30–39; Saskatchewan uses code 30; Manitoba uses S/U; Nova Scotia uses ACAD/ADV; New Brunswick uses level 2; Newfoundland and Labrador uses 3000 courses and Academic or Honours status; PEI uses 611 or 621. British Columbia and Yukon use five Grade 12 academic courses with the BC graduation certificate.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 3

requirements.label: Canada · Ontario and Quebec routes
requirements.details: Ontario requires the OSSD and six Grade 12 academic U, DU or M courses, including at most one M course. Average at least 80%, with every score at least 70%; at most two maths and two languages count. A private school outside Ontario needs an Ontario Ministry agreement. An Ontario private school must be inspected and authorised to grant OSSD credits. For Quebec the guide lists the two-year pre-university DEC.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Diploma Eligibility List · September 2027 · p. 3

requirements.label: Caribbean · CAPE or CXC qualification
requirements.details: For the CAPE Diploma or the CXC Associate Degree, WUR asks for three or more double units in general or academic subjects and an overall grade from I through V.

requirements.label: China · Gaokao and senior school grades

requirements.label: English proficiency · tests and speaking grades
requirements.details: For IELTS Academic, WUR asks for 6.0 overall and 6.0 speaking. TOEFL iBT requires 80 with speaking 20 on the 120-point scale, or 4.5 overall with speaking 4.0 on the six-point scale. PTE Academic requires 61 overall and 56 speaking. These three tests must be taken within 24 months before applying. IELTS online, One Skill Retake, TOEFL Home Edition and MyBest scores are excluded.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Bachelor’s language requirements

requirements.label: Cambridge English and Dutch-school English evidence
requirements.details: WUR lists B2 First at 169–190, C1 Advanced at 169–210 and C2 Proficiency at 180–230. A Dutch VWO diploma with English Language and Literature also meets the English requirement. With HAVO the English grade must be 7, or 6 together with an English-taught HBO propedeutic year.

requirements.label: Dutch nationals · VWO diploma after 2009
requirements.details: The Studielink deadline is 1 August for Dutch nationals with a Dutch VWO diploma awarded after 2009. Osiris submission does not apply to this group. The general fee deadline for Dutch nationals is 15 August.

requirements.label: Using the IB Diploma for English proficiency
requirements.details: WUR accepts a complete diploma taught solely in English apart from one other language course. Alternatively, with the full diploma, obtain 5 in English A Literature or Language and Literature at either level, 6 in English B HL, or 7 in English B SL.

requirements.label: Additional Dutch-language evidence
requirements.details: Dutch-taught degrees require Dutch as well as English. WUR lists a Dutch-taught MBO4, HAVO or VWO diploma, the NT2-II diploma, a VWO Dutch language and literature certificate, or CNaVT Educatief Startbekwaam or Educatief Professioneel. For the full IB Diploma, Dutch A Literature or Language and Literature needs 5 at SL or HL.

requirements.label: Apply through Studielink and Osiris
requirements.details: Start in Studielink. Applicants without a Dutch VWO diploma must also submit the Osiris application. A recent grade list can start the assessment. WUR then specifies any conditions and certified documents in the individual decision letter.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Bachelor’s application procedure and deadlines

requirements.label: Non-EU/non-EFTA applicants · filing and documents
requirements.details: Apply in Studielink by 15 April and submit the Osiris documents by 1 May. WUR gives 1 July for certified documents and fees. If diploma results arrive between 1 and 15 July, the documents can arrive up to 15 July. Visa processing starts after documents and payment; predicted grades cannot be used to arrange the entry visa. Confirm dates for the intended intake.

source.title: Wageningen University & Research · Bachelor’s application procedure and deadlines

requirements.label: EU/EFTA applicants and Dutch applicants without VWO
requirements.details: Register through Studielink by 15 June and submit the Osiris documents by 1 July. The fee deadline is 15 August and the deadline for certified admission documents is 31 August. Confirm dates for the intended intake.
